EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

TimeOfDay.description: A time of day on a 24-hour clock, HH:MM, such as "06:30" — quoted in YAML.

description: This person's job: who employs them, where, which hours each day, the wage, and what a shift produces for the employer.

employer.description: Who employs them: an organization key.

from.description: When the shift begins, every day.

manages.description: Whether this employee manages the employer's staff: told of their lateness and offered `penalize` when lateness costs money. At most one per employer (`ARC-287`).

produces.description: What one full shift produces for the employer: an item key, then how many (at least 1).

title.description: What the job is called, in prose: 1 to 40 bytes, no control character. Optional; where the world enables `attributes`, it is the holder's `employment.occupation` (S30-f, Q-S30f-3).

until.description: When the shift ends, the same day: after `from`.

wage.description: The wage, in minor units per hour worked, paid by the employer.

workplace.description: Where they work: a place key.
